retrievalProfile.description: Use this skill for creating 1960s psychedelic album covers featuring solarized, high-contrast color effects over grainy group photography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men in vintage attire posed in a surreal, outdoor-like setting with a massive, solarized tree-like structure in the background that bleeds vibrant, unnatural pinks, yellows, and oranges against a muted, grainy sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The central solarized tree acts as a vibrant backdrop for the dark-clad figures.
The figures are arranged in a tiered, triangular composition.
The foreground features textured elements like rope and wicker furniture to ground the surrealism.
The typography is tucked into the upper right corner, balancing the heavy visual weight of the left-side figures.
coreInvariants: High-grain film texture across the entire image.
Solarized color bleed effect on the central foliage.
Muted, desaturated skin tones contrasted with neon-saturated background elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, varying in scale from seated to standing.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central standing figure in the patterned coat provides a vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the vibrant solarized tree, moves down to the central figure, and then scans the seated members on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides breathing room for the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted teal and grey-blue in the sky and foreground.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and browns in the clothing of the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta, electric yellow, and orange in the solarized tree.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background 'aura' versus low saturation and high contrast in the human subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase only for a modern-vintage feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for minimalist impact against a complex background.
graphicDevices: Small black rectangular label in top left corner for catalog numbers.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and lowercase charm.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1960s-style photograph of a band in vintage clothing. Apply a solarization effect to a large tree behind them, using neon pink and yellow. The sky should be a muted, grainy teal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the upper right corner in a bright yellow color with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background tree solarized with neon colors?
Is there a visible film grain texture?

postGenerationChecks: Check for solarization artifacts in the foliage.
Ensure the text is bright yellow and lowercase.
Verify the overall image has a matte, grainy finish.
Confirm the composition is bottom-heavy with the band.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Band Photo + Solarized Foliage Overlay + Lowercase Geometric Sans-Serif = Psychedelic Folk-Rock Aesthetic
